senses.gloss: (corr. פְּרוֹזְבִּיָּין) adv. (πρὸς βίαν, or βίαιον) by force, against one’s will.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:4">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>חֵּעָשֶׂה את פ׳ שליח וכ׳</he> thou must be the messenger (to go) between us and the Lord (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 20:19">Ex. XX, 19</cite>).
